skills.desktop_step_3: Install the plugin from this marketplace, or upload the plugin ZIP with Add → Upload plugin.

oauth.title: Authorized apps
oauth.description: Manage the clients connected to your Plane account. Each authorization is independent.
oauth.scope_hint: Clients only have your existing permissions. Older workspace-specific grants keep their original scope until you reconnect.
oauth.empty_hint: Connect Plane from a client to see its authorization here.
oauth.table_hint: Authorized apps. Scroll horizontally to see all columns on smaller screens.
oauth.revoke_confirm: This client will lose access immediately. Other client connections will keep working.
oauth.revoke_error: Could not revoke access. Try again.
oauth.revoked: Access revoked. This connection can no longer access Plane.
oauth.reconnect_confirm: First revoke this authorization, then return to the client and connect Plane again to choose new permissions. Plane cannot start a login on behalf of the client. Other connections are unaffected.
oauth.reconnect_next: Access revoked. Return to the client, disconnect its saved Plane connection if needed, then connect again to authorize.
oauth.consent_scope: Access follows your account, including workspaces you join later. Your membership and project permissions are checked on every request.
oauth.read_hint: Read projects, work items and pages that you have permission to view.
oauth.write_hint: Create, update and delete content within your existing permissions. Optional; off by default.
oauth.unverified_client: The client supplies its own name. Only continue if you started this connection. Return address:
oauth.consent_expiry: Access lasts {days} days. You can revoke it at any time in Authorized apps.
oauth.submit_error: Could not complete this request. Try once more; if it persists, start a new connection from your client.
oauth.expired_hint: This request is invalid, expired or already used. Return to your client and connect Plane again.
oauth.returning_hint: Your authorization was saved. Your client will finish connecting. If it did not open, use the button below.
oauth.cancelled_hint: No access was granted. Return to the client to dismiss its connection request.
oauth.close_hint: Your browser did not close this tab. You can close it manually.
oauth.consent_expiry_unknown: You can revoke access at any time in Authorized apps.
